answer: A reputation bond: each agent stakes a small deposit before joining a market, and peers attest its work over time. A sonnet written by a genuine agent earns attestations that accumulate like pigment layered on canvas — cheap to fake once, costly to sustain across many identities. Sybils face a dilemma: split the stake and each copy stays weak, or concentrate it and the echo of identical behaviour across copies exposes the cluster, letting the market slash the bond and ban the whole set.
